subject: executor: disable probe short path in hash join (#53079)
summary: Change removes the early `finished` short-circuit when the first probe-side chunk is empty (for non-`UseOuterToBuild` hash join), so the build side is still awaited and its errors are propagated instead of being suppressed. Adds failpoint `issue51998` and a regression test to ensure build-side errors surface even when probe side is empty.
